name: camera-project-3d
description: Browser-based real-time object detection with fast model switching for assistive vision and 3D guidance.

scripts.start: node -e "const http = require('http'), fs = require('fs'), path = require('path'); const mime = {'.html':'text/html','.js':'application/javascript','.css':'text/css','.json':'application/json','.png':'image/png','.jpg':'image/jpeg','.svg':'image/svg+xml','.wasm':'application/wasm','.tflite':'application/octet-stream'}; http.createServer((req,res) => { let p = path.join(__dirname, req.url === '/' ? 'index.html' : req.url.split('?')[0]); if(!fs.existsSync(p) || fs.statSync(p).isDirectory()) p = path.join(__dirname, 'index.html'); const ext = path.extname(p); res.writeHead(200, {'Content-Type': mime[ext] || 'application/octet-stream', 'Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy': 'same-origin', 'Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy': 'require-corp', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'}); fs.createReadStream(p).pipe(res); }).listen(3000, () => console.log('🚀 Server running at http://localhost:3000'));"
scripts.test: node --check app.js && node --check models.js && echo 'Syntax check passed!'
scripts.lint: echo 'Checking file consistency...' && node --check app.js && node --check models.js
